_comment: Settings of the THIRD run, prepared 26 Nov 2026: restart from 5,000 EUR at the owner's request, wider crypto universe (OKX added, USDT-quoted coins). The owner's wish is 30-100 trades a day and 1,000 EUR a day; 1,974 short-term technique variants were back-tested on a month of data before this run and none was profitable after costs, so until the owner decides otherwise ONLY lab-validated strategies trade. Agent-consensus trading is off (it lost in runs 1 and 2). Protective rules: take profit at +1.5% net, stop to break-even after +0.8%, loss capped at -1.2% per position, day stopped at -3%. Runs 1 and 2 are archived in backup/run1-2026-11-13-state.json and backup/run2-2026-11-16-state.json.
